figurative_meaning_en: The state of laughing so uncontrollably that one rolls on the floor
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কৌতুক শুনে সবাই হেসেই খুন হয়ে গেল।
সিনেমার কমেডি দৃশ্য দেখে আমরা হেসেই খুন।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone died laughing at his joke.
We rolled on the floor laughing at the comedy scene in the movie.
note: This idiom captures the exaggerated joy in Bengali expressive culture, often used in informal settings.
